facts.fact: Police in Mansa arrested Kennedy Mwansa, 38, for allegedly insulting President Hakainde Hichilema in a TikTok video, charging him under the Cyber Crimes Act with harassment using electronic gadgets; the arrest date is not given, the police statement was on Friday 2026-09-11 and the video was reported to police on 2026-09-09, so the statement date is used.
